@@U01591@@
And the magic flow Of his talk, the bliss In the clasp of his hand, And oh! his kiss! My peace is gone, My heart is sore, Ill find it never And never more. My heart cries out, My sad heart pines, To hold him fast, And keep him mine, And kiss him, kiss him, Night and day, And on his kisses Die away!

@@U01596@@
Promise me, 海因里希!

@@U01598@@
Whatever I can.

@@U01600@@
Well—religion. How do you feel about it? You're such a kind, such a good-hearted man, and yet it seems not to matter much to you.
translation:
@@U01591@@
还有他谈话的神奇流动，他紧握的手的幸福，哦！他的吻！我的平静消失了，我的心很痛，我永远不会再找到它。我的心呼喊，我悲伤的心渴望，紧紧抓住他，让他属于我，亲吻他，亲吻他，日日夜夜，在他的亲吻中死去！

@@U01596@@
答应我，海因里希！

@@U01598@@
尽我所能。

@@U01600@@
嗯——宗教。你对此有何感想？你是一个多么善良、多么心地善良的人，然而这对你来说似乎并不重要。
